findings.evidence: Lines 247-275 contain exactly three massless lemmas; `exp_two_mul_rapidity_add_of_realPhoton` (line 134) has no `_of_masslessTarget` counterpart. With `M = 0`, `p = E`, the general form gives `(2k + E - E)/(E + E) = k/E`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem exp_two_mul_rapidity_of_masslessTarget ... : exp (2 * (q + P).rapidity n) = k / E`, proved from `exp_two_mul_rapidity_add_of_realPhoton (M := 0) hn hq hq' hP (spatialPart_eq_of_massless hP' hE0.le)` plus `sqrt_sq_sub_zero_sq`.
findings.issue: The `Massless` section mirrors three of the four massive-target relations (`W² = 4kE`, `2k = W e^{y}`, `2E = W e^{-y}`) but omits the massless specialisation of `exp_two_mul_rapidity_add_of_realPhoton`, i.e. `e^{2y} = k / E` — the standard UPC form `y = ½ log(k/E)`, and the relation the §1.4 change of variables to invariant mass and rapidity needs. A consumer holding `P.spatialPart = -E • n` cannot reach it from the general lemma either, since `spatialPart_eq_of_massless` (line 243) is `private`.

findings.evidence: `grep -rn isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero code/` returns only the declaration (Basic.lean:102) and four docstring mentions; no proof term uses it.
findings.fix: Either add the corollary that makes the prose a theorem and gives the new lemma its consumer — `theorem isReal_of_spatialPart_eq_smul (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) (hq : q.timeComponent = γ.energy) (hq' : q.spatialPart = γ.energy • n) (hγ : γ.virtuality = -⟪q, q⟫ₘ) : γ.IsReal := PhotonKinematics.isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero (minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero_of_spatialPart_eq_smul hn hq hq') hγ` — or drop `isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero` and the realness claims from those two docstrings.
findings.issue: `PhotonKinematics.isReal_of_minkowskiProduct_self_eq_zero` is public but has no consumer anywhere in the repo — it appears only inside docstrings (InvariantMass.lean:40,212,223; Basic.lean:21). Correspondingly, the docstrings of `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_realPhoton_energyFraction` (line 215) and `energyFraction_eq_exp_rapidity_mul_sub_div_sqrt` (line 226) claim the photon is real, but neither statement constrains `γ.virtuality` at all, so nothing in the post-PR API ever derives `γ.IsReal` from a collinear four-momentum.

findings.evidence: Line 180 `have hWpos : 0 < √⟪q + P, q + P⟫ₘ := hB ▸ by positivity`, where `hB` comes from the `private theorem exp_rapidity_mul_targetEnergy_add_momentum` at line 167; no public declaration states `0 < √⟪q + P, q + P⟫ₘ`.
findings.fix: Expose it as a public lemma (e.g. `sqrt_minkowskiProduct_add_self_pos`, with the same `hn hq hq' hP hP' hk hE0` hypotheses) next to the division forms, and use it in the two division lemmas.
findings.issue: Positivity of the invariant mass, `0 < √⟪q + P, q + P⟫ₘ`, is established only inside `two_mul_photonEnergy_eq_exp_rapidity_mul_sub_div_sqrt` via the `private` lemma `exp_rapidity_mul_targetEnergy_add_momentum`. Every consumer that inverts `2k = e^{y}(W² - M²)/W` or `x = e^{y}(W² - M²)/(2 W E_s)` for `W` needs the same fact and must re-derive it.

summary: The rapidity surface is clean (body unexposed, `rapidity_def`/`tanh_rapidity`/`exp_rapidity`/`exp_two_mul_rapidity` plus both light-cone components and the cosh/sinh forms), but the massless-target section omits the one textbook relation it otherwise mirrors, and the `IsReal` lemma added to `Basic.lean` has no consumer while two docstrings assert realness that no statement establishes.
